description: Light canvas; grey rounded box upper-left with black serif text starting 'Q. My daughter-age 4.5-maintains she wants a billion-story building...' and attribution '-Keira, via Steve Brodovicz, Media, PA'; stick figure at left holding a sheet of paper; large empty black-outlined rectangle (board) centre-right.
Small stick figure (hair bun) holding a red marker/pen appears sitting on the top-right corner of the board; single activity frame.
Same as opening plus the seated marker figure at board top-right; board still empty.
Over 6 frames a red hand-drawn building (windows) at right edge plus red lettering 'YAY!' 'BILLION!' 'BIG!' and 'THIS IS A MILLION!' fades in from pale pink to full red.
Red building doodle with 'YAY!' 'BILLION!' 'BIG!' 'THIS IS A MILLION!' at upper right; seated marker figure; board empty.
Second stick figure with hard hat appears at right below the seated figure (shrug pose).
Hard-hat stick figure at right beside board; red building doodle and labels above it.
Black lattice tower/crane drawing with small red marks appears at lower-right edge; hard-hat figure's arms look changed (pose swap) - MEDIUM.
Board empty; lattice tower at lower right; hard-hat figure; red doodle upper right; left figure with paper.
Black ink drawing of a tall tower on a small hill with two small clouds appears inside the board.
Tall tower on hill with small clouds inside board.
Tower replaced by a collapsed rubble heap on the hill with red curved arrows pointing down onto it.
Rubble heap with red arrows inside board.
New object in the board right of the rubble: thin vertical line (rod) ending in a grey sphere at bottom, plus a tiny dot to its right.
Board shows rubble heap at left and vertical rod with sphere at right-centre plus tiny dot.
Rod tilts to the left at its lower end, pivoting at the sphere; top fragment shows small scatter marks.
Rod tilted further (leaning lower-left) with the sphere; rubble heap at left.

Hard cut at 20.46s from the board scene to a flat red title card: black dinosaur on a black satellite drawing at top, white text 'xkcd's' 'what if?' 'THE VIDEO SERIES'. Card unchanged in tiles through 22.04s; the last tile (22.46s) is a new scene: black-and-white drawing of two stick figures at a table with small jelly mounds. Exact onset of the second cut is UNRESOLVED (between 22.04s and 22.46s).
No board. Left stick figure holding a small tool and right stick figure with hair bun stand at a table with several small jelly mounds on a plate.
Jelly mounds replaced by one taller wobbling dome with wobble marks; right figure's arm raised; left figure holds trowel.
Wobbling jelly dome on table; two figures; right figure arm raised.
Dome replaced by tall tiered jelly castle with tiny flag top; speech label 'BARAD-DUR-LICIOUS!' with leader line appears upper right; right figure arm lowered.
Tall tiered jelly castle on table with speech label 'BARAD-DUR-LICIOUS!'.
Castle and label replaced by collapsed jelly heap spread over the table with three red downward arrows; both figures change pose (leaning back); label gone.
Collapsed heap on table with red arrows; two stick figures.
Hard cut to black-ink drawing of a very tall skyscraper (Burj-like) with small clouds and low skyline at bottom; no characters.
Tall skyscraper with clouds and skyline at bottom.
Skyscraper replaced by rubble pile at bottom with red arrows (one down at centre, two curved outward); clouds remain.
Rubble pile with red arrows; clouds above.
Hard cut to black line drawing of a suburban house at bottom with a vertical black axis line at left labelled '10m'.
House at bottom against a vertical axis with tick '10m'.

Over 15 frames the canvas scales/scrolls with motion blur: house shrinks to lower-left, axis labels change 10m then 100m then '1 km', and a row of progressively taller building silhouettes appears left to right, tallest at right.
Vertical axis with ticks 10m 100m 1 km; row of buildings of increasing height, tallest skyscraper right of centre.
Second blurred zoom-out over 14 frames: axis labels go 1 km / 100m to 2 km / 3 km, buildings shrink toward bottom-left, extra taller blur shapes pass at right.
Axis ticks 100m 1 km 2 km 3 km; row of small buildings with tallest near 2 km on the left half; right side empty.
Large rubble heap of broken building blocks with three red arrows appears at right, reaching to about 3 km on axis.
Building row at left and collapsed rubble heap with red arrows at right; axis 100m-3 km.

Hard cut to hard-hat stick figure at left and a framed board titled 'HIGH BUILDING PROBLEMS' with bullets 'ACROPHOBIA' 'EFFICIENT HEATING' 'WIND' 'GETTING ELEVATOR MUSIC THAT'S LONG ENOUGH' 'FINDING A GOOD NAME' (last line cut off at frame bottom).
Hard-hat figure and board 'HIGH BUILDING PROBLEMS' with five bullets.
Red ellipse is drawn around the bullet 'WIND' over 5 frames (starts at left of word, closes by f1250).
Board with 'WIND' circled in red.
Hard cut to tall skyscraper centre with many wavy black wind lines across the sky and low skyline at bottom.
Skyscraper with wavy wind lines.
Wind lines look slightly rearranged and tower top slightly different versus previous hold, but difference is unreadable at tile scale; UNRESOLVED.
Skyscraper upright with wind lines.
Skyscraper leans to the right (slight bend) with tiny marks near upper section.
Skyscraper leaning right with wind lines.
Tower broken: a short stump remains at left-centre and the upper part is tilted flying up-right with small motion marks.
Stump at lower-centre and detached upper part tilted at upper right; wind lines.
Hard cut to plain canvas with two stick figures side by side (right one with hair, hand at chin).
Two stick figures centre on plain canvas.
Elevator cutaway pops on around/behind: shaft with cable above and a platform on the right carrying a stick figure with hat; two figures remain at left.
Two figures at left; elevator car platform with hat figure at right; cable and shaft at top.

Hard cut to tall narrow elevator shaft (lattice and panel), hot-air balloon upper right, tiny stick figure with catapult at lower right; text 'I WISH I COULD BE CATAPULTED UP THE BUILDING INSTEAD...' left and 'YEEESSSS!!' right.
Elevator shaft, balloon, catapult with tiny figure, both speech labels.
Hard cut to a grey vertical-stripe tapered building in a frame with labels 'ELEVATORS' and 'ROOMS' with arrows.
Striped building with 'ELEVATORS' and 'ROOMS' labels.
Hard cut to a sign 'SKYLOBBY' with five elevator arrow icons, red stick figures with red curved arrows, building column at right, and small label 'ARE YOU WAITING FOR THE TOP FLOOR TOO?'.
Skylobby sign with red figures and arrows; building stack at right; bottom-right question text; no ELEVATORS/ROOMS labels.
Labels 'ELEVATORS' and 'ROOMS' with arrows appear at upper right of the building stack.
Skylobby panel, building with labels 'ELEVATORS' 'ROOMS', and the question text.

Hard cut to an easel with painted skyscraper (left), stick figure centre, and a figure with hair next to a stack of paper; speech 'WE COULD BUILD A SWIMMING POOL ON THE MOON FOR THIS AMOUNT OF MONEY...'.
Easel, stick figure, woman beside paper stack with speech about swimming pool on the moon.
Hard cut to construction scene: building floor with windows and crane beam, two hard-hat figures at right; speech '1 FLOOR DONE, ONLY 999,999,999 TO GO.'
Same construction scene; framing appears slightly different from G0064 tile (possible small push-in; INFERRED, UNRESOLVED).
Hard cut to white canvas: title 'GOAL : 1,000,000,000', labels 'HOUSE' and 'SKYSCRAPER' with curved arrows, a thin striped vertical house bar and a tall skyscraper.
'GOAL : 1,000,000,000' header; HOUSE bar and SKYSCRAPER.
Counter 'FLOORS 100' appears above the GOAL line; frame appears slightly rescaled (skyscraper taller).
'FLOORS 100' and 'GOAL : 1,000,000,000'; HOUSE bar and SKYSCRAPER.

Over 16 frames canvas zooms/scrolls with heavy blur (stack-chain, mountains, clouds pass); FLOORS counter changes 100 to 10,000; new labels '100 SKYSCRAPERS' 'MOUNTAINS' 'AIRPLANES' appear; header stays fixed.
'FLOORS 10,000'; labels '100 SKYSCRAPERS' 'MOUNTAINS' 'AIRPLANES'; skyscraper and thin vertical line.
Label 'MEGA-SKYSCRAPER' appears with arrow; tower redrawn taller/segmented; labels repositioned lower.
Segmented tower labelled 'MEGA-SKYSCRAPER'; '100 SKYSCRAPERS' 'MOUNTAINS' 'AIRPLANES'.
Over 6 frames a faint grey small meteor drawing and label 'METEORS' fade in at left of tower.
Tower with labels incl. 'METEORS' at left; FLOORS 10,000.

Over 14 frames heavy-blur zoom/scroll upward past large blurred words 'SPACE' over 'AIR'; FLOORS 10,000 to 1,000,000; labels change to '100 MEGA-SKYSCRAPERS'; curved horizon line at bottom with small 'SPACE' 'AIR'.
'FLOORS 1,000,000'; label '100 MEGA-SKYSCRAPERS'; tower; small 'SPACE' 'AIR' near bottom curve.
Label 'MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPER' with arrow appears at right of tower; tower slightly taller.
Tower labelled 'MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPER' and '100 MEGA-SKYSCRAPERS'.
Small marks (debris/junk bits with tiny arrows) appear and increase in number left of tower over 6 frames; unreadable at tile scale.
Several tiny debris marks left of tower.
Label 'SPACE STATION' with arrow to a dot appears at lower left.
Label 'SPACE STATION' plus debris marks.
Label 'SPACE JUNK' with arrow appears above 'SPACE STATION'.
Labels 'SPACE JUNK' and 'SPACE STATION'; tower; FLOORS 1,000,000.

Over 15 frames heavy-blur zoom/scroll out (thick black lines converge to thin lines); FLOORS 1,000,000 to 100,000,000; labels fade (tower labels greyed at start); ends with a long thin tilted tower beside a vertical line and '100 MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPERS' label, bottom text 'EARTH' partly cropped.
'FLOORS 100,000,000'; two near-vertical lines from bottom (reference line and slightly tilted tower); label '100 MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPERS'.
Label 'MEGA-MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPER' with arrow appears at right of tower.
Labels '100 MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPERS' and 'MEGA-MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPER'.
Small label 'MOON' with tiny drawing appears above the tower top.
Tower diagram with 'MOON' label at top.
Hard cut to two stick figures (large one with cap, smaller one with hair tuft), each with scribbled motion circles and small balls spinning around raised hands.
Cap figure and small figure with spin scribbles.
Hard cut to a swing carousel ride with chairs swung outward on chains and a tiny stick figure at lower right.
Swing carousel with outward chairs; ride looks slightly larger than in G0094 tile (INFERRED small reframing).
Hard cut to globe (grey Earth with continents) with labels 'WEIGHT MAXIMUM' (top, two small figures on surface) and 'WEIGHT MINIMUM' (right) with force arrows 'Fg' and 'Fc'.
Globe with weight labels and force arrows.
Globe diagram reduced and shifted left; black orbit arcs and two satellites with red arrows added at right; labels retained.
Globe with weight labels, orbit arcs and two satellites with red arrows.
Hard cut to Earth (left) and Moon (small dark disc, right) with brackets labelled 'GRAVITY WINS' (short) and 'CENTRIFUGAL WINS' (long).
Earth, Moon, and brackets 'GRAVITY WINS' 'CENTRIFUGAL WINS'.
Red dashed circle is drawn around Earth over 6 frames (arc grows from left); red label '1/10TH TO THE MOON' appears below.
Red dashed circle around Earth with label '1/10TH TO THE MOON'.
Thin black rod/line starts from Earth edge towards the right, short length.
Rod extends from Earth to just beyond the red circle.
Inset window cutaway appears lower right with leader line to rod: stick figure holding a clipboard/phone inside a window with starry black pane.
Rod, inset window with figure, red circle.
Rod extends all the way to the Moon with small joint marks; composition appears shifted upward by a small amount; inset window larger.
Rod from Earth to Moon; brackets; red circle; inset window.
Hard cut to black background: grey Earth centre with a thin tall tower pointing up, grey Moon upper right with trailing dashed arc, curved dashed lines lower left/right.
Black space scene: Earth, upright tower, Moon with dashed orbit.
White-outlined box upper left containing rubble pile with a red X, connected by a line to the base of the tower.
Box with rubble and red X linked to tower base.
Box disappears; tower now lifted off/tilted away from Earth with a small stub at the Earth surface and fragments at top.
Tower detached and tilted above Earth; Moon at right.

Hard cut to black canvas with a long vertical white diagram: wavy tall line with coil, small device and sparkle top, label '10 MEGA-MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPERS' with arrow to a vertical dotted line; 'EARTH' and 'MOON' at bottom.
Long tower diagram with label '10 MEGA-MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPERS', 'EARTH', 'MOON'.
Label 'KEIRA-SKYSCRAPER' with arrow appears right of the top part.
Diagram with labels '10 MEGA-MEGA-MEGA SKYSCRAPERS', 'KEIRA-SKYSCRAPER', 'EARTH', 'MOON'.

Hard cut to close-up white-line drawing on black: spherical dome with oval holes and three antenna-like stalks on a segmented stalk; arrow with text '~220 km/s' pointing left; faint curved lines at right.
Dome with ovals and antennas; arrow '~220 km/s'.
Satellite with solar panels appears upper left with a thin line/arc to a small hand/figure on the dome.
Dome, satellite at upper left, '~220 km/s' arrow.
Hard cut to a grey spiral galaxy (shaded, star points) with satellite at upper left and a thin line from the satellite to the galaxy.
Spiral galaxy and satellite with connecting line.
Hard cut to a thin vertical white tower diagram (coil, device, top sparkle) on black with scattered stars and a small comet at right.
Thin tower on black with stars and comet.
Faint dotted particles appear along the lower part of the tower; unreadable at tile scale.
Thin tower with faint dots beside its middle and a small comet.
Hard cut to a grey-shaded cratered sphere with three antennae, a segmented worm-like tail at lower left, curved lines, and a glowing white sun with rays at upper right on black.
Cratered sphere with antennae and tail; sun upper right.

Hard cut to red credits card: dinosaur/satellite drawing at left, text 'GET THE BOOKS: xkcd.com/books', four book covers, credit names at right (Randall Munroe, Henry Reich, Lizah van der Aart, Ever Salazar, Know Art Studios).
Red credits card unchanged: book covers and credits.
